name: fence-exact
description: Rounding edges of a rectangle pathing texture's quarter turn (make-fence.mjs exact: NOfl 8x2, NOal Fence45 and VOal Fence135 at every multiple of 45 degrees from -405 to 765 as single precision, NOfl every quarter degree within 2 degrees of 45, 135, 225 and 315). The doodads and the pathing map each saves

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
